## What's new

**📜 Log tab** ([#4](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/4))
- A running list of who joined, left or moved between voice rooms in your servers, with the time, person, room and server.
- People coming into or leaving the room you're in are tagged **YOUR ROOM**, even if they aren't your friends.
- Filter by Everything, Friends, My room or Me, or search by name.
- Click a person to DM them, a room to open it, or a server to go to it. Right-click any of them for Discord's own menu (or a short menu when it isn't in the sidebar).
- Keeps the last 500 events in memory until Discord restarts.

**🙈 Hide someone from In voice** ([#3](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/3))
- Right-click a user → **Hide from In voice**. They stop showing up in In voice, don't bring a room into the list and don't count in the badge.
- Hidden people show as a row of chips under In voice; click ✕ or right-click → **Show in In voice** to bring them back.

Both features are in the BetterDiscord version too.

## Update

Vencord: click the new-version notification on Windows or macOS, or download `FriendsInVoice-v1.13.0.zip` and run `install.bat` on Windows or `install.command` / `bash install.sh` on macOS.

BetterDiscord: replace your plugin file with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release.

## Verification

Vencord TypeScript check, lint and build passed, plus all 30 plugin tests and all 15 BetterDiscord port tests. The release ZIP passes the plugin's own update package check.
